questions: Best known for pioneering radical behaviorism at Harvard, this psychologist invented a chamber for studying operant conditioning that came to bear his name — who is he?
B. F. Skinner: American psychologist and social philosopher (1904–1990)
This Nepalese Himalayan massif's highest peak is the 10th tallest on Earth, and its north face was first summited by a French expedition led by Maurice Herzog in 1950 — which range?

Annapurna (mountain range) is a massif in the Himalayas in north-central Nepal that includes one peak over 8,000 metres (26,247 ft), thirteen peaks over 7,000 metres (22,966 ft), and sixteen more over 6,000 metres (19,685 ft).

William James: American philosopher and psychologist (1842–1910)
